_about: Rules for the PS1 English voice audio (Sessions 2e-2g). Scene ids are subtitle scene ids (set + scene).

A15.why: Lake boat repair. The US disc's stream clip 15 (the usual A n = s00 rank n) is the Japanese track (it matches the PSP's bsr.at3, correlation 0.99); the English dub is clip 18 (confirmed by ear). The PSP also has bsr2.at3, a variant of the same scene (shares about half its audio with bsr, no subtitle table); the US disc has only this one English version, so it goes into both bsr.at3 and bsr2.at3.

code_voice._about: Voice clips the game code starts directly (not the text): the City Hall news reports (Session 2n audit). --audio=en: the bank-6 path-array entries of these clips point at the PS1 English clips (PS1 voice bank 11, matched by content in script/subtitles.csv C scenes); the code's ids stay Japanese, so they still start the news subtitle scenes C00-C04, which carry English text (tools/build_subtitles.py). Project decision 2026-09-30 (English news audio; English news subtitles). Session 2n's first version repointed the ids in code instead (test47-49), which stopped the subtitles.

kept_japanese_audio._about: Japanese audio kept on purpose in --audio=en (project decision 2026-09-30, after listening; logs/jp_audio_audit.md).
kept_japanese_audio.xa37s00/cd00long.at3: PSP credits theme (long): no match on the PS1 disc; the project owner: 'too good to replace'.
kept_japanese_audio.PSP_GAME/SND0.AT3: PSP menu preview sound: PSP-only, no English equivalent.
